title: UPDATE: Mubadala Seeds $500M Fund for Departing Ventures Head to Preserve AI Pipeline
summary:
Abu Dhabi's Mubadala Capital is providing the initial capital for a new investment vehicle to be led by its exiting ventures chief, as the firm seeks to preserve its pipeline of deals within the U.S. artificial intelligence sector. The $500 million fund will operate independently, allowing the firm to maintain its influence in the tech market without having a sovereign wealth fund appearing on the capitalization tables of every startup it backs.

The move comes as Apollo invests $5 billion for a stake of just under 10% in Mubadala Capital, the asset management arm of Abu Dhabi's $385 billion sovereign wealth fund. Despite the minority investment and the departure of its ventures head, the state fund retains a majority share of the manager and maintains full control over all investment decisions.
